detail.longDescription: I'm Michael, a career changer moving into security from Highway Construction. To learn hands-on enterprise IT and OT, I am building a mini-SOC on Kubernetes in my homelab, playing a (fictional) MSSP that defends an equally fictional manufacturing client. Running ElasticSearch, Suricata, Zeek, Trivy, and Infisical. At RSS this week. If you see me, say hi! # introduction # infosec # homelab # kubernetes # Elasticsearch # careerchange # RocSecSummit
